clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: "Effective Date" means the date of signing. "Delivery Date" means the date set out in the purchase order.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This agreement runs for 2 years from the Effective Date.

clauses.heading: Delivery
clauses.text: On or before the Delivery Date, Supplier must deliver the goods.

clauses.heading: Price
clauses.text: The price per unit is fixed for the Term and may not be increased.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.text: Buyer shall pay each invoice within 60 days of the invoice date.

clauses.heading: Late Payment
clauses.text: If Buyer fails to pay under Clause 5, interest of 2% per month applies to the overdue amount.

clauses.heading: Warranty
clauses.text: Supplier warrants that the goods are free from defects for 24 months from the Delivery Date.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Confidential Information shall be kept secret by each party for 3 years after this agreement ends.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 90 days written notice. Interest accrued under Clause 6 survives termination.

clauses.heading: Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: Disputes shall be settled by arbitration in Delhi.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of India.

clauses.heading: Force Majeure
clauses.text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
